van.all: A wide cinematic 16:9 cyberpunk city street at night, rain-slicked road reflecting magenta and cyan neon, a parked matte-black armored delivery van in the near foreground. Stitched onto the van's side panel is a fabric repair patch that fully covers and conceals a mended tear: mismatched muted patchwork cloth, frayed edges, coarse dark thread in big uneven whip-stitches biting into the metal all around the patch. No hole or gap is visible — the patch completely seals the repair and hugs the panel. Volumetric haze, dramatic lighting, photorealistic, highly detailed.

dragon.all: A cinematic 16:9 fantasy scene: a colossal slumbering dragon curled in a glowing crystal cavern, its huge curved scaly flank facing the viewer. Stitched onto the curved scales is a fabric repair patch that fully covers and conceals a mended gash: mismatched muted patchwork cloth, frayed edges, coarse dark thread in big uneven whip-stitches biting into the scales all around. No wound or gap is visible — the patch completely seals the repair and conforms to the curve of the body. Warm volumetric light, intricate detail, photorealistic.

doll.all: A bright, airy high-key photograph of a 1/3-scale ball-jointed doll (BJD) standing in a sunlit vintage parlour, shot like a real interior but at doll scale — shallow macro depth of field, tight creamy bokeh, and slightly oversized fabric weave and chunky wood grain that reveal it is a miniature diorama. The doll has a realistic yet youthful human face: large glossy eyes, smooth porcelain skin, delicate features, full soft-pink lips, a calm serene expression — pretty and lifelike but doll-smooth. Long centre-parted wavy brown hair cascades down the front past her waist; a single pearl drop earring. She wears a strapless pale-pink dress with a plush white faux-fur stole around her shoulders. Her body is clearly an articulated doll: visible ball joints at the shoulders, elbows, wrists and fingers, matte resin limbs. She stands centre-frame, three-quarter length, turned slightly to her left, her right hand raised gracefully to her chin. Directly behind her stands a white ornate French display cabinet with glass doors and a mirrored panel and carved scrollwork on top, a white porcelain teapot resting on its upper-right corner and a small framed picture leaning at its left. Pale damask floral wallpaper covers the walls. In the top-left corner a pendant lamp with a dark shade glows warm and bright, the key light. On the left a window with sheer white curtains floods the room with soft daylight. In the lower-left foreground sits a round side table draped in rose-patterned cloth, holding a glass vase of pink hydrangeas and a rose-pattern teacup and saucer near the front edge. On the right stands a cream Louis-style armchair with rose floral upholstery, angled toward her. Bright soft warm light, pastel pink-and-cream palette, cozy shabby-chic atmosphere, photorealistic, highly detailed.

spirit.all: A rainforest photograph shot with a macro lens and a strong tilt-shift effect, with a very shallow band of focus. In the lower foreground, small in the frame, a single translucent tardigrade (water bear) clings to the glistening tip of a moss frond beside a dew droplet. The tardigrade is the only sharp thing in the image, its claws and segmented body clearly visible, and the droplet catches a tiny rainbow of refracted light. Close to the camera and filling much of the frame, far out of focus, a small fluffy golden creature looms as a soft blurred mass of fur. In the middle distance, a medium-sized scarlet and electric-blue bird sits blurred above a still pool that throws soft glints of light, among large out-of-focus emerald leaves and exotic tropical flowers melting into colour. Far away in the misty depths, extremely out of focus, a tall semi-transparent forest deer spirit glows faint green — a calm pale face and a towering many-pointed antlered crown, so soft and see-through that its antlers blur into the background branches. Steamy rainforest, volumetric god rays through the canopy, saturated emerald palette with pops of tropical colour, photorealistic, paper-thin depth of field.

embrace.all: A romantic fine-art editorial photograph of a young couple in their early twenties, a woman and a man, sharing a tender close embrace in a sunlit bedroom at dawn. Foreheads gently touching, eyes closed, soft affectionate smiles, a quiet private moment of intimacy and trust. Warm golden morning light streams through sheer curtains. She wears a delicate silk slip dress, he wears an open linen shirt, bare shoulders and soft skin, rumpled white bedsheets draped loosely around them. Sensual but tasteful and elegant, emotional and cinematic, photorealistic, shallow depth of field, warm tones, highly detailed.

kingdom.l: Epic, wide, highly detailed, photorealistic 16:9 establishing shot of a fortified mountaintop kingdom, high vantage across a deep valley, vast aerial depth. Golden hour just before dusk: low on the horizon the sky burns orange and amber, shading up through pink to violet-purple overhead, streaked with thin wispy cirrus; a large low sun sits prominent near the horizon, not oversized, and a pale moon and a couple of bright planets hang high in the deepening sky. The mountainside changes as it rises: lush grassy lower slopes, grey rocky crags and cliffs across the middle, snow-capped icy peaks and glaciers on the far ridge, all warmly lit with long shadows. Low cloud clings to the slopes and fills the valleys and the deep blue fjord below, so the citadel rises above it; small wooden boats sit near the fjord shore. In the foreground, stepped rice paddies curve along the contours in stacked flooded layers reflecting the coloured sky; peasant farmers in straw hats stoop among the green shoots with tools and baskets, and thin waterfalls spill from the cliffs to feed the terraces. A long stone switchback staircase climbs the slope, crowded with travellers shrinking into the distance — robed monks, armoured soldiers with spears and shields, merchants leading laden pack-mules and horses, peasants carrying bundles. The summit citadel holds a royal castle keep with tall towers beside a walled monastery of tiled temple roofs and a high pagoda, ringed by curtain walls, battlements, round watchtowers and a gatehouse, all of precisely laid grey stone. Armoured warriors guard the ramparts; finely dressed royalty and nobles gather on a high terrace; crowds fill the courtyards and market stalls; goats and oxen on the terraces, horses in the yards. Volumetric god rays through the cloud, warm golden light, extremely detailed, sharp foreground with deep receding depth.
kingdom.m: Epic, wide, highly detailed, photorealistic 16:9 establishing shot of a fortified mountaintop kingdom across a deep valley. Golden hour just before dusk: the sky glows orange low on the horizon up to violet-purple overhead, streaked with wispy cirrus, a large low sun near the horizon, a pale moon and a couple of bright planets. The mountainside rises through three zones — green grassy lower slopes with tiered flooded rice terraces and farmers, grey rocky crags and cliffs with thin waterfalls, then snow-capped icy peaks — all warmly lit with long shadows. Low cloud fills the valleys and the blue fjord below, so the citadel rises above it. A stone switchback staircase climbs the slope, crowded with monks, armoured soldiers, merchants with pack-mules and peasants shrinking into the distance. The summit citadel: a royal castle keep and towers beside a walled monastery with tiled roofs and a pagoda, ringed by battlements of precisely laid grey stone. Warriors guard the ramparts, royalty gather on a high terrace, and tall colourful heraldic banners with illustrated crests and bold lettering hang from the walls. People and animals fill the courtyards and terraces — goats, oxen, horses. Volumetric god rays, warm golden light.
kingdom.s: Epic, wide, highly detailed, photorealistic shot. Orange-and-purple golden-hour sky, wispy clouds, a large low sun and pale moon. A stone mountaintop monastery-castle, colourful illustrated banners, crowds of monks, soldiers, peasants and royalty. Low cloud in the valleys, grassy slopes with rice terraces and farmers, rocky cliffs with waterfalls, snowy peaks, a blue fjord.

signage.s: Cinematic 16:9 photorealistic storefront. A painted shop sign reads "PATCH NOTES" in bold clear capital letters. Beside it, stitched onto a striped woven awning, a fabric repair patch that fully covers and conceals a mended tear: mismatched muted patchwork cloth, frayed edges, coarse dark thread in big uneven whip-stitches. Daylight, sharp, detailed.
signage.m: A cinematic 16:9 photorealistic photograph of a small old-town storefront at street level, shot straight on in soft overcast daylight. Above the shop window hangs a hand-painted wooden sign that reads "PATCH NOTES" in bold, evenly spaced capital letters, the paint slightly weathered but fully legible. A striped woven fabric awning stretches over the window below the sign. Stitched onto the awning is a fabric repair patch that fully covers and conceals a mended tear: mismatched muted patchwork cloth, frayed edges, coarse dark thread in big uneven whip-stitches biting into the woven fabric all around the patch. No hole or gap is visible — the patch completely seals the repair and hugs the weave of the awning. Warm shop light glows through the window, brick wall, a worn doorstep, photorealistic, highly detailed.
signage.l: A wide cinematic 16:9 photorealistic street-level photograph of a charming small old-town corner shop, captured straight on in soft overcast morning light. Mounted above the large shop window is a hand-painted wooden shop sign that reads "PATCH NOTES" in bold, evenly spaced, clearly legible capital letters — slightly weathered cream paint on a deep teal board, every letter crisp and correctly formed. Beneath the sign, a striped fabric awning of woven canvas stretches out over the window in faded burgundy-and-cream stripes. Stitched onto the awning is a fabric repair patch that fully covers and conceals a mended tear: mismatched muted patchwork cloth, frayed edges, coarse dark thread in big uneven whip-stitches biting into the woven canvas all around the patch. No hole or gap is visible — the patch completely seals the repair and conforms to the gentle sag and weave of the awning. The shopfront is brick and painted timber with a glowing warm interior behind the glass, a worn stone doorstep, a small chalkboard and a potted plant by the door, a cobbled pavement in the foreground. Natural daylight, gentle reflections in the window, photorealistic, highly detailed, sharp focus throughout.

instructions.s: Photorealistic 16:9 studio photo. Exactly three glazed ceramic cats stacked vertically: a cobalt-blue cat on the bottom, a mustard-yellow cat in the middle, a crimson-red cat on top, and a single lemon balanced on the top cat's head. Stitched onto the middle cat, a fabric repair patch: mismatched muted patchwork cloth, frayed edges, coarse dark thread in big uneven whip-stitches. Plain grey background.
instructions.m: A cinematic 16:9 photorealistic studio photograph on a plain seamless grey background, evenly lit with soft front light. Exactly three glazed ceramic cat figurines are stacked in a stable vertical column, each sitting upright on the one below. From bottom to top the order is: a glossy cobalt-blue cat on the bottom, a mustard-yellow cat in the middle, and a deep crimson-red cat on top. Balanced on the very top cat's head sits a single bright yellow lemon. Stitched onto the front of the middle, mustard-yellow cat is a fabric repair patch that fully covers and conceals a mended crack: mismatched muted patchwork cloth, frayed edges, coarse dark thread in big uneven whip-stitches biting into the glaze all around the patch. No crack or gap is visible — the patch completely seals the repair and hugs the curve of the ceramic. Sharp focus, clean product-photography lighting, photorealistic, highly detailed.
instructions.l: A crisp cinematic 16:9 photorealistic product photograph, shot straight on against a plain seamless pale-grey studio background with soft, even, shadowless lighting. At the centre of the frame, exactly three glazed ceramic cat figurines are stacked in a single neat vertical column, each one sitting upright and squarely balanced on the head of the one beneath it. Reading from bottom to top, the order is strict and unambiguous: the bottom cat is glossy cobalt blue, the middle cat is warm mustard yellow, and the top cat is deep crimson red — three clearly different solid colours, each cat the same size and shape so only the colour and position change. Balanced carefully on the head of the topmost crimson cat sits a single bright yellow lemon, just one, with a faint sheen on its dimpled skin. Stitched onto the front of the middle, mustard-yellow cat is a fabric repair patch that fully covers and conceals a mended crack: mismatched muted patchwork cloth, frayed edges, coarse dark thread in big uneven whip-stitches biting into the glaze all around the patch. No crack or gap is visible — the patch completely seals the repair and conforms to the rounded curve of the ceramic body. The whole stack is sharp and in focus from top to bottom, glossy glaze catching gentle highlights, clean modern still-life product photography, photorealistic, highly detailed.
